tools.name: book_demo
tools.description: Help the user book a personalized demo with MoeGo. Scrolls to the demo form or navigates to /demo.

tools.name: download_app
tools.description: Help the user download the MoeGo mobile app. Detects the device and redirects to the correct app store.

tools.name: get_business_solution
tools.description: Find the right MoeGo solution for a specific pet care business type. Supports: mobile grooming, salon, boarding, daycare, retail, hybrid, enterprise, franchise, training, pet sitting, dog walking. Navigates to the relevant page or returns available options.

business_type.description: Type of pet care business (e.g. "mobile grooming", "boarding", "enterprise")

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Get frequently asked questions about MoeGo. Works best on /faq. Optionally filter by keyword.

tools.name: get_feature_info
tools.description: Find information about a specific MoeGo feature. Supports: scheduling, online booking, payment/POS, messaging, reports, KPI dashboard, multi-location, marketing, reviews, membership, accounting, automation, task management, team management, operations, customer experience, scaling, product demo. Navigates to the feature page or returns available features.

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.description: Read the text content of the current MoeGo page. Returns headings, paragraphs, feature descriptions, and other visible text. Optionally read a specific section by ID.

section.description: Optional section ID (e.g. "features", "compare-table"). Omit to read the full page.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get MoeGo pricing plans and feature comparison. Reads from the page if on /pricing, otherwise navigates there.

tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.description: Help the user join a waitlist for upcoming MoeGo features. Available waitlists: training, dog walking, pet sitting.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a MoeGo page or scroll to a section. Supports 40+ pages including all feature pages, business type pages, and resource pages. Examples: "/pricing", "/online-booking", "/pet-grooming-software", "#features".

tools.name: search_page
tools.description: Search for a keyword or phrase on the current page. Returns all text paragraphs that contain the search term. Useful for finding specific information.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for

tools.name: subscribe_newsletter
tools.description: Scroll to the MoeGo newsletter subscription form on the current page.
